# Test AppKit generation with Application filter
# Verifies that filtering works correctly and produces valid output

# Generate AppKit bindings filtered to Application-related symbols
env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework AppKit -input $INPUT_DIR -filter Application -output testoutput
stderr 'Generating.*AppKit'
stderr 'Generated bindings'
stderr 'Filter.*Application.*matched'

# Verify key files were generated
exists testoutput/appkit/doc.gen.go
exists testoutput/appkit/functions.gen.go

# Check package name is correct
grep 'package appkit' testoutput/appkit/doc.gen.go
grep 'package appkit' testoutput/appkit/functions.gen.go

# Verify Application function is present
grep 'Application' testoutput/appkit/functions.gen.go

# Check that generated code is valid Go
exec go vet testoutput/appkit/doc.gen.go
exec go vet testoutput/appkit/functions.gen.go
